THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT
(CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No:- B/E/3/Acquisitions/Malip/canal.
Land Ministry No.:- 4/3/9/2015/IR/220.

I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquirethe following lands required for the construction of the canalline from the Malipoththa tank:
Description of the Land to be acquired:
